notes.title: Mari and Bayu - The Road Home is now available!
notes.notes:
Here it comes! Mari and Bayu - The Road Home is now available! 

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/b1a60c0a8ce209abbb291c53981e5beafc6a5ca0.png[/img]

You can buy the game here:

notes.title: Meet Mari and Bayu - The Road Home!
notes.notes:
Today we are proud to present you Mari and Bayu - The Road Home, a new co-op platform adventure game. 

[url=]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=G-6Xxi5p0SA[/url]

Help Mari, an ant princess, to get back to her home while getting her brother back after his disapearance. Mari will not be alone during this perilous adventure, as Bayu, a magical firefly, will help her during his own mission to save his kidnapped family across the world.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/981841ab3f6340dc9da90bf61f24a2f3e4f5608a.png[/img]

Explore this world alone or in cooperation and experience the world through the perspective of an ant.

And as you know (or not) the Steam Next Fest is starting today. We know that you all loooove to try games before buying them so we've prepared a demo for you to try during this event from today 10am PST / 7pm CET to the 28th of February!

Please mind that this demo will not be representative of how the game will be at launch and that we will take into account all your demo's feedback to make the best game possible. Meanwhile, enjoy the ride in this ant-sized world !

You can now wishlist the game here but don't forget to follow Mari and Bayu: The Road Home to get the latest news!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1725350/Mari_and_Bayu__The_Road_Home/
